'''Heritage tapestries''' were wall hangings created to tell stories or depict moments in history. These tapestries filled the pillared halls of the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], depicting the history of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="CSWE" /> Many ancient heritage tapestries depicting the [[First Great Schism|First]] and [[Second Great Schism]]s of the Order remained within the [[Chamber of Antiquities/Legends|Chamber of Antiquities]], the lower levels of the [[Great Jedi Library/Legends|Great Jedi Library]] on the lost world of [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]].<ref name="NoP" />
